text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho and I visit the art museum. Our mission is to learn what we can from an exhibition featuring photos of Tiara tour Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After overhearing another visitor say that racers on the Classic Triple Crown tour are better than those on the Triple Tiara tour, Sweep Tosho is outraged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that the tour doesn't matter because strength is strength, she struggles to accept that the world at large feels differently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides she's going to destroy these assumptions and wake everyone up. And to help her do that, she's going to find her racing magic and use it to change the world.
